arabic_text: وَكَمْ مِّنْ ثَنَاءٍ جَمِيلٍ لَّسْتُ أَهْلاً لَّهُ نَشَرْتَهُ
transliteration: wa kam min thanaa'in jameelin lastu ahlan lahu nashartahu
english_text: And how much beautiful praise, for which I was unworthy, You have spread abroad!

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ عَظُمَ بَلائِي وَأَفْرَطَ بِي سُوءُ حَاِلي وَقَصُرَتْ بِي أَعْمَاِلي وَقَعَدَتْ بِي أَغْلاَلِي
transliteration: allāhumma ʿaẓuma balāʾī wa'afraṭa bī sū'u ḥālī wa qasurat biy a'mali waqa'adat biy aghlālī
english_text: O Allah, my tribulation is tremendous, And my bad state is excessive, And my acts are inadequate, And my fetters have tied me down,

arabic_text: وَحَبَسَنِي عَن نَّفْعِي بُعْدُ آمَاِلي وَخَدَعَتْنِي الدُّنْيَا بِغُرُورِهَا وَنَفْسِي بِجِنَايَتِهَا (بِخِيَانَتِهَا) وَمِطَاِلي
transliteration: wa ḥabasanī ʿan nafʿī buʿdu āmālī wa khadaʿatnī al-dunyā bi-ghurūrihā wa nafsī bi-jināyatiha (bi-khiyānatihā) wa miṭāli
english_text: And my far-fetched hopes have held me back from my gain And this world with its delusions, my own soul with its offences and my delay have deceived me.

arabic_text: يَا سَيِّدِي فَأَسْأَلُكَ بِعِزَّتِكَ أَن لا يَحْجُبَ عَنْكَ دُعَآئِي سُوءُ عَمَلِي وَفِعَاِلي وَلا تَفْضَحْنِي بِخَفِيِّ مَا اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سِرِّي وَلا تُعَاجِلْنِي بِالْعُقُوبَةِ عَلَى مَا عَمِلْتُهُ فِي خَلَوَاتِي مِنْ سُوءِ فِعْلِي وَإِسَاءَتِي،
transliteration: yā sayyidī fa'as'aluka biʿizzatika an lā yaḥjuba ʿanka du'ā'ī su'ūʾ ʿamalī wa fiʿ walā tafḍaḥnī bi-ḵafīyyi mā aṭṭalaʿta ʿalayhi min sirrī walā tuʿājilnī bil-ʿuqūbat alā mā ʿamilthu fī khalawātī min suu'i fi'li wa isa'ati
english_text: O my Master! So I ask You by Your might not to let my evil works and acts veil my supplication from You, And not to disgrace me through the hidden things You know of my secrets And not to hasten me to punishment for what I have done in private: My evil acts in secrecy and my misdeeds

arabic_text: وَدَوَامِ تَفْرِيطِي وَجَهَالَتِي وَكَثْرَةِ شَهَوَاتِي وَغَفْلَتِي
transliteration: wadawāmi tafriṭī wa jahālatī wa-kathrati shahawati wa-ghaflatī
english_text: And my continuous negligence and my ignorance And my manifold passions and my forgetfulness.

arabic_text: وَكُنِ اللَّهُمَّ بِعِزَّتِكَ لِي فِي كُلِّ الأَحْوَاِل رَؤُوفًا وَّعَلَيَّ فِي جَمِيعِ الأُمُورِ عَطُوفًا
transliteration: wa kunillāhummah biʿizzatika lī fī kulli al-aḥwāli raʾūfan wa ʿalayya fī jamiʿi al-umūri ʿatūfan
english_text: And by Your might, O Allah, be kind to me in all states And be gracious to me in all affairs!

arabic_text: إِلَهِي وَرَبِّي مَن لِّي غَيْرُكَ أَسْأَلُهُ كَشْفَ ضُرِّي وَالْنَّظَرَ فِي أَمْرِي!
transliteration: allahumma rabbi man li ghayruka as'aluhu kashfath dhurri wal-nathara fi amri!
english_text: My God and my Lord! Have I any but You from whom to ask removal of my affliction and regard for my affairs!

arabic_text: إِلَهِي وَمَوْلايَ أَجْرَيْتَ عَلَيَّ حُكْمًا اتَّبَعْتُ فِيهِ هَوَى نَفْسِي، وَلَمْ أَحْتَرِسْ فِيهِ مِن تَزْيِيْنِ عَدُوِّي،
transliteration: ilāhī wa mawlāy 'ajrayta 'alayya ḥukman ittabaʿtu fīhi hawā nafsī walam ahtaris feehi min tazyini ʿaduwwi
english_text: My God and my Protector! You put into effect through me a decree in which I followed the caprice of my own soul And did not remain wary of adorning my enemy.

arabic_text: فَغَرَّنِي بِمَا أَهْوَى وَأَسْعَدَهُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ القَضَاءُ فَتَجَاوَزْتُ بِمَا جَرَى عَلَيَّ مِنْ ذَلِكَ بَعْضَ حُدُودِكَ وَخَالَفْتُ بَعْضَ أَوَامِرِكَ
transliteration: fagharreni bima ahwā waasʿadahu ʿalā dhālika al-qadāʾ fatajaawaztu bimaa jaraa `alayya min dhaalika ba`da hudoodika wa-khalaf-tu baʿḍa awaamirika
english_text: So he deluded me through my soul's caprice and therein destiny favoured him So, in what was put into effect through me in that situation, I transgressed some of Your statutes And disobeyed some of Your commands.

arabic_text: فَلَكَ الْحُجَّةُ عَلَيَّ فِي جَمِيعِ ذَلِكَ وَلا حُجَّةَ لِي فِيمَا جَرَى عَلَيَّ فِيهِ قَضَاؤُكَ، وَأَلْزَمَنِي حُكْمُكَ وَبَلاؤُكَ
transliteration: falaka al-ḥujjatu ʿalayya fī jamiʿi dhalika wa lā ḥujjata lī fīmā jarā ʿalayya fīhi qaḍāʾuka wa alzamani hukmuka wa balauka
english_text: So Yours is the argument against me in all of that I have no argument in what Your destiny put into effect through me therein nor in what Your decree and Your tribulation imposed upon me.

arabic_text: وَقَدْ أَتَيْتُكَ يَا إِلَهِي بَعْدَ تَقْصِيرِي وَإِسْرَافِي عَلَى نَفْسِي مُعْتَذِرًا نَّادِمًا، مُّنْكَسِرًا مُّسْتَقِيلاً مُّسْتَغْفِرًا مُّنِيبًا،
transliteration: waqad ataytuka ya ilahi baʿda taqṣīrī wa isrāfī ʿalā nafsī muʿtaḏiran nādiman munkasiran mustaqilan mustaghfirun muniban
english_text: Now I have come to You, My God, after my shortcoming and my immoderation toward myself, Proffering my excuse, regretful, Broken, apologizing, Asking forgiveness, repenting,

arabic_text: مُّقِرًّا مُّذْعِنًا مُّعْتَرِفًا
transliteration: muqirran mudhʿinan muʿtarifan
english_text: Acknowledging, submissive, confessing.

arabic_text: لا أَجِدُ مَفَرًّا مِّمَّا كَانَ مِنِّي وَلا مَفْزَعًا أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْهِ في أَمْرِي غَيْرَ قَبُولِكَ عُذْرِي، وَإِدخَاِلكَ إِيَّايَ فِي سَعَةٍ مِّن رَّحْمَتِكَ
transliteration: lā ajidu mafarran mimmā kāna minnī wa lā mafzaʿan atawajjah ilayhi fī amrī ghayra qabulika ʿudhri, wa-idkhalika iyyaya fi saʿatin min rahmatik
english_text: I find no place to flee from what occurred through me, Nor any place of escape to which I may turn in my affairs, Other than Your acceptance of my excuse and Your entering me into the compass of Your mercy.

arabic_text: اَللَّهُمَّ فَاقْبَل عُذْرِي وَارْحَمْ شِدَّةَ ضُرِّي وَفُكَّنِي مِنْ شَدِّ وَثَاقِي يَا رَبِّ ارْحَمْ ضَعْفَ بَدَنِي وَرِقَّةَ جِلْدِي وَدِقَّةَ عَظْمِي
transliteration: allāhumma fāqbil ʿudhrī wa arham shiddat al-durri wafukkanī min shaddi wathāqī yā rabbar raḥma ḍaʿfa badanī wa riqqata jildī wa diqqata ʿaẓmī
english_text: O Allah, so accept my excuse, Have mercy upon the severity of my affliction And release me from the tightness of my fetters, My Lord, have mercy upon the weakness of my body, the thinness of my skin and the frailty of my bones.

arabic_text: يَا مَنْ بَدَأَ خَلْقِي وَذِكْرِي وَتَرْبِيَتِي وَبِرِّي وَتَغْذِيَتِي هَبْنِي لابْتِدَآءِ كَرَمِكَ وَسَاِلفِ بِرِّكَ بِي
transliteration: yā man badā'a kh alqī wa dhikrī wa tarbīyatī wa birrī wa taghdhīyatī habnī labtidāʾi karamika wa sāilfi birrika bī
english_text: O Thou who gave rise to my creation, to the remembrance of me, to the nurture of me, to goodness toward me and to nourishment on me, Bestow upon me for the sake of Your having given rise [to me] with generosity and Your previous goodness to me!

arabic_text: يَا إِلَهِي وَسَيِّدِي وَرَبِّي
transliteration: yā ʾilāhī wa-sayyidī wa-rabbī
english_text: O Allah, my Master and my Lord!

arabic_text: أَتُرَاكَ مُعَذِّبِي بِنَارِكَ بَعْدَ تَوْحِيدِكَ وَبَعْدَ مَا انْطَوَى عَلَيْهِ قَلْبِي مِن مَّعْرِفَتِكَ وَلَهِجَ بِهِ لِسَانِي مِنْ ذِكْرِكَ وَاعْتَقَدَهُ ضَمِيرِي مِنْ حُبِّكَ
transliteration: aturāka muʿaẓẓibī binārika baʿda tawḥīdika wa baʿda mā inṭawā ʿalayhi qalbī min maʿrifatika walahijabihi lisani min dhikrika waʿtaqadahu ḍamīrī min ḥubbika
english_text: Can You see Yourself tormenting me with Your fire after I have professed Your Unity And after the knowledge of You my heart has embraced, And the remembrance of You my tongue has constantly mentioned And the love of You to which my mind has clung,

arabic_text: وَبَعْدَ صِدْقِ اعْتِرَافِي وَدُعَائِي خَاضِعًا لِّرُبُوبِيَّتِكَ
transliteration: wa baʿda ṣidqi iʿtirāfī wa duʿāʾī khāḍiʿan li rubūbiyyatika
english_text: And after the sincerity of my confession and my supplication, humble before Your lordship?

arabic_text: هَيْهَاتَ أَنْتَ أَكْرَمُ مِنْ أَنْ تُضَيِّعَ مَن رَّبَّيْتَهُ أَوْ تُبْعِدَ مَنْ أَدْنَيْتَهُ أَوْ تُشَرِّدَ مَنْ آوَيْتَهُ أَوْ تُسْلِمَ إِلىَ الْبلآءِ مَن كَفَيْتَهُ وَرَحِمْتَهُ
transliteration: hayhāta ʾanta ʾakramu min ʾan tuḍayyaʿa man rabbaytahu aw tubʿida man adnaytahu aw tusharrida man awaytahu aw tuslima ila al-balāʾi man kafaytahu waraḥmatuhu
english_text: Far be it from You! You are more generous than that You should squander him whom You have nurtured, Or banish him whom You have brought nigh, Or drive away him whom You have given an abode Or submit to tribulation him whom You have spared and shown mercy.

arabic_text: وَلَيْتَ شِعْرِي يَا سَيِّدِي وَإِلَهِي وَمَوْلايَ أَتُسَلِّطُ النَّارَ عَلَى وُجُوهٍ خَرَّتْ لِعَظَمَتِكَ سَاجِدَةً وَعَلَى أَلْسُنٍ نَّطَقَتْ بِتَوْحِيدِكَ صَادِقَةً وَّبِشُكْرِكَ مَادِحَةً وَعَلَى قُلُوبٍ اعْتَرَفَتْ بِإِلَهِيَّتِكَ مُحَقِّقَةً
transliteration: walayta shiʿri yā sayyidī wa-ilāhī wa-mawlāyā atusalḷiṭu nanāra ʿalā wuǧūhin kharraṭ liʿaẓamatika sājidatan wa ʿalā al-sunni nataqat bi tawḥīdika ṣādiqatan wa bi shukrika mādḥatan wa ʿalá qulūbin ʿitráfat bi-ilahīyatik muhaqqiqatan
english_text: Would that I knew, my Master, My God and my Protector, Whether You will give the Fire dominion over faces fallen down prostrate before Your Tremendousness, And over tongues voicing sincerely the profession of Your Unity and giving thanks to You in praise, And over hearts acknowledging Your Divinity through verification,

arabic_text: وَعَلَى ضَمَائِرَ حَوَتْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ بِكَ حَتَّى صَارَتْ خَاشِعَةً وَعَلَى جَواِرحَ سَعَتْ إِلَى أَوْطَانِ تَعَبُّدِكَ طَائِعَةً وَّأَشَارَتْ بِاسْتِغْفَارِكَ مُذْعِنَةً
transliteration: wa ʿalā ḍamaʾir ḥawat min al-ʿilmi bika ḥattā ṣārat khāshiʿatan waʿalā jawāriḥa saʿat ilā awṭān taʿabbudika ṭāʾiʿatan wa ashārat bi istighfārika
english_text: And over minds encompassing knowledge of You until they have become humble And over bodily members speeding to the places of Your worship in obedience and beckoning for Your forgiveness in submission.

arabic_text: مَّا هَكَذَا الظَّنُّ بِكَ وَلا أُخْبِرْنَا بِفَضْلِكَ عَنْكَ يَا كَرِيمُ، يَا رَبِّ وَأَنْتَ تَعْلَمُ ضَعْفِي عَنْ قَلِيلٍ مِّن بَلآءِ الدُّنْيَا وَعُقُوبَاتِهَا، وَمَا يَجْرِي فِيهَا مِنَ الْمَكَارِهِ عَلَى أَهْلِهَا
transliteration: mā hakadhā aẓẓannu bika walā ukhbirnā bifadlika ʿanka yā karīmu, yā rabbī wa anta taʿlamu ḍaʿfī ʿan qalīlin min balāʾi ad-dunyā wa ʿuqūbātihā wa mā yajrī fīhā min al-makārihi ʿalā ahlihā
english_text: No such opinion is held of You! Nor has such been reported - thanks to Your bounty — concerning You, O All-generous! My Lord, And You know my weakness before a little of this world's tribulations and punishments, And before those ordeals which befall its inhabitants,

arabic_text: عَلَى أَنَّ ذَلِكَ بَلآءٌ وَّمَكْرُوهٌ قَلِيلٌ مَّكْثُهُ، يَسِيرٌ بَقَآؤُهُ، قَصِيرٌ مُّدَّتُهُ
transliteration: ʿalā anna dhālika balāʾun wa makrūhun qalīlun makhthuhu, yasīrun baqāʾuhu, qasīrun mudd
english_text: Even though it is a tribulation and ordeal whose stay is short, whose subsistence is but little and, whose period is but fleeting.

arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ احْتِمَاِلي لِبَلآءِ الآخِرَةِ وَجَلِيلِ وُقُوعِ الْمَكَارِهِ فِيهَا!
transliteration: fakaifa ihtimālī libalāʾ al-ākhirah wa jalīl waqūʿi al-makārihi fīhā!
english_text: So how can I endure the tribulations of the next world and the great ordeals that occur within it?

arabic_text: وَهُوَ بَلآءٌ تَطُولُ مُدَّتُهُ، وَيَدُومُ مَقَامُهُ، وَلا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْ أَهْلِهِ لِأَنَّهُ لا يَكُونُ إِلا عَنْ غَضَبِكَ وَانْتِقَامِكَ وَسَخَطِكَ وَهَذَا مَا لا تَقُومُ لَهُ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَالأَرْضُ
transliteration: wa huwa balāʾun taṭūlu muddatuhu, wa yadūmu maqāmuhu, wa lā yukhaffafu ʿan ahlihi li'annahu la yakun illa 'an ghadabika wa intiqamika wa sakhatika wa-hādhā mā lā taqūmu lahū as-samāwātu wal-arḍu
english_text: For it is a tribulation whose period is long, whose station endures and whose sufferers are given no respite, Since it only occurs as a result of Your wrath, Your vengeance and Your anger, And these cannot be withstood by the heavens and the earth.

arabic_text: يَا سَيِّدِي فَكَيْفَ بِي
transliteration: yā sayyidī fakayfa bī
english_text: O Master, so what about me?!

arabic_text: وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ الضَّعِيفُ الذَّلِيلُ الْحَقِيرُ الْمِسْكِينُ الْمُسْتَكِينُ
transliteration: wa ana ʿabduka al-ḍaʿīfu al-ẓalīlu al-ḥaqīru al-miskīnu al-mustakīnu.
english_text: For I am Your weak, lowly, base, wretched and miserable slave.

arabic_text: يَا إِلَهِي وَرَبِّي وَسَيِّدِي وَمَوْلايَ
transliteration: yā ʾilāhī wa rabbī wa sayyidī wa mawlāya
english_text: My God! My Lord! My Master! My Protector!

arabic_text: لِأَيِّ الأُمُورِ إِلَيْكَ أَشْكُو
transliteration: li-ayyi al-umoori ilayka ashku
english_text: For which things would I complain to You?

arabic_text: وَلِمَا مِنْهَا أَضِجُّ وَأَبْكِي
transliteration: walimā minhā 'aḍijju wa'abkī
english_text: And for which of them would I lament and weep?
